jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Engineering - Product

Fully Remote - US

Base $210k - $240k + Competitive Equity

FutureTech Recruitment is partnered with a Series A EdTech startup backed by mission-aligned investors. The platform has strong commercial traction across multiple US states with strong NRR and a deeply mission-driven team with deep roots in the industry they serve. Series B on the horizon within 8-12 months.

They’re hiring a Director of Engineering - Product to report directly to the CTO and co-founder, taking ownership of multiple product squads. 50/50 hands-on IC and leadership to start, shifting to 80/20 over time. Real ownership of architecture decisions, squad delivery, and cross-functional alignment across a mission-driven team.

Responsibilities

Own multiple product squads - managing engineers and driving delivery across all of them
Hands-on early - contributing code, code reviews, and pairing (~50/50 IC to leadership, shifting to 80/20 over time)
Make and land key technical architecture decisions to ensure the platform scales for the next two years of growth
Partner with Product, Customer Success, and cross-functional stakeholders to align engineering priorities to business outcomes
Ship high-value product features on time, including advancing AI-powered capabilities

Requirements

2-3+ years managing multiple engineering teams (6+ engineers) - ideally including managing other managers
Hands-on technical ability - reads, reviews, and writes code; not a pure people manager
Strong backend architecture experience - able to ramp on new stacks (React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, MongoDB)
Experience owning major business verticals, products, and business outcomes (speed, quality, growth, retention)
Startup or high-growth environment experience - comfortable with ambiguity and independent prioritisation
Strong communicator - connects technical decisions to business outcomes and drives cross-functional alignment
Mission-driven - genuine passion for the education space
Able to travel for company retreats twice a year plus 2-4 additional business trips
No new visa sponsorship required - transfers considered

Tech Stack

React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, MongoDB

Series A, strong commercial traction, strong NRR, and Series B on the horizon within 8-12 months. Full benefits including health, parental leave, 401(k), unlimited PTO, and coworking access. If you’re a hands-on engineering leader who wants real ownership at a mission-driven startup with genuine product-market fit, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Engineering Manager

Onsite 5 days/week - San Francisco, CA

Base $415k - $450k + RSUs

FutureTech Recruitment is partnered with a well-backed AI startup now operating within a global enterprise - combining startup speed with enterprise scale and distribution. Their platform uses advanced ML and generative AI to turn complex unstructured documents into reliable structured data, used daily by some of the largest professional services firms in the country. The culture is high-octane and hands-on - everyone ships, including leadership.

They’re hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to serve as a player-coach leading one of the core engineering teams - reporting directly to the CTO and co-founder. You’ll manage 4-7 staff and principal-level engineers (scaling to 10-12), stay an active technical contributor, and own hiring, onboarding, and team growth as the org scales.

Responsibilities

Directly manage 4-7 engineers (scaling to 10-12) at staff and principal level while staying an active technical contributor - writing code, reviewing designs, and debugging hard problems weekly
Ship customer-facing, eval-driven AI products that turn unstructured documents into reliable structured data for enterprise customers
Develop exceptional engineers through direct feedback, coaching technical and product judgment, and growing future leaders
Own hiring, onboarding, and team growth - building a high-talent-density engineering org from the ground up
Connect engineering decisions to real business outcomes - working closely with domain experts and customer-facing teams

Requirements

10-20 years of software engineering experience spanning IC work and formal leadership progression
Formal engineering management experience (TLM, Senior TLM, or Director) managing 2-10 direct reports
Still hands-on in code - writes production software weekly if not daily, reviews designs and PRs, debugs hard problems alongside senior engineers
Built or led external, customer-facing products at tech-forward, high-octane product companies
Backend, backend infrastructure, or full-stack with a backend lean
People leadership - sets clear expectations, gives direct feedback, coaches technical and product judgment, addresses performance early
Exposure to ML/AI systems - agentic or retrieval-based systems, document AI, or eval-driven development a plus
Python, TypeScript, and cloud infrastructure a plus

Tech Stack

Python, TypeScript, Cloud Infrastructure, Document AI, Agentic Systems, Retrieval-Based Systems

Startup speed meets enterprise scale. $415k-$450k base, RSU grant, and competitive equity. If you’re a deeply technical engineering leader who wants to build and lead a world-class team at a company reshaping how a major professional services industry operates, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Manager, EDT Solution Delivery AEM (Remote)
jobs.description:
What you will do:

As our Senior Manager, EDT Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), you will lead the end-to-end platform ownership and delivery of Stryker's Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) environment, which powers Stryker.com and 50+ country sites globally as the foundation of Stryker's Digital Marketing Program. You will partner directly with the Digital Marketing organization, EDT business partners, Marketing Operations, and external system integrators to drive scalable content authoring, content globalization, comprehensive campaign insights, and modern cloud architecture across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), and integrated Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities. Additionally, you will lead a team of full-time employees and managed-service partners spanning AEM technical architects, backend/frontend developers, DevOps engineers, QA, and analytics consultants, ensuring the platform delivers on brand consistency, speed-to-market, operational efficiency, and enhanced customer experience objectives aligned with Stryker's Mission.

Own the end-to-end AEMaaCS platform strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), Dynamic Media, Multi-Site Manager (MSM), and the AEM Translation Integration Framework (TIF).
Lead architecture governance for the component library, page templates, blueprint/live-copy configurations, and language-copy rollouts supporting Stryker.com and 50+ country sites.
Drive modernization efforts (e.g., AMS-to-AEMaaCS migration, technical debt reduction, out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption) to enable scalable content authoring, globalization, and advanced marketing analytics.
Ensure seamless integration between AEM and adjacent platforms including Workfront, Adobe Analytics, Adobe WebSDK, Marketo, Adobe Target, and Adobe Real-Time CDP.
Oversee CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, release management, and the AEM Releases & Deployment Schedule in partnership with DevOps and system integrators.
Partner with the AEM AI initiative team to evaluate and operationalize built-in generative AI capabilities (content creation, asset tagging, experimentation) in alignment with Stryker's AI Operating Committee (AIOC) governance and residual-risk approvals.
Ensure platform compliance with Stryker IT QMS, SOX, CSV, Global Change Control, privacy/consent regulations, and cybersecurity standards.
Execute a robust talent offense by attracting, developing, retaining, and engaging top talent while driving personal/professional growth of individuals and the team, delivering high-quality results with passion, energy, and drive.
Manage a team consisting of full-time employees, contractors, and managed-service partners; define roles and responsibilities, plan for the department's future needs, counsel employees on performance, and contribute to employee pay decisions or changes.
Lead and mentor Solution Leads, Technical Leads, and Solution Analysts across build and run teams (onshore and offshore).
Serve as the EDT single point of accountability for the AEM platform to Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Corporate Communications, and Divisional marketing stakeholders.
Own program schedules, work breakdown structures, and integrated Gantt/roadmap views for the AEM portfolio.
Implement quality, risk, and procurement management strategies and templates for AEM projects and programs.
Ensure smooth build-to-run transitions of completed projects and stable production support operations.

What you need:

Required:

Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of professional experience in IT and/or digital application development, including people leadership experience.
7+ years of hands-on experience delivering and operating Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.x and/or AEMaaCS) solutions in a global enterprise environment.
5+ years of experience leading MSM/translation strategies, DAM architecture, component-based design, and Adobe WebSDK integrations.
2+ years of experience with track record managing global system integrators and hybrid onshore/offshore delivery models.
2+ years of experience with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud (Analytics, Target, Real-Time CDP, Commerce) preferred.
5+ years of experience with SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and IT QMS/regulatory compliance (SOX, privacy, consent).

Preferred:

Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Adobe Certified Expert / Master (AEM Sites, AEM Assets, or AEM Architect) strongly preferred.
PMP, SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification preferred.
Prior experience in medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry preferred.

Posted Date: 09/14/2026 This role will be posted for a minimum of 3 days.

United States of America Pay Ranges:

USN: $135,600 - $225,900 USD Annual
US5: $142,400 - $237,200 USD Annual
US10: $149,200 - $248,500 USD Annual
US15: $155,900 - $259,800 USD Annual
US20: $162,700 - $271,100 USD Annual
US30: $176,300 - $293,700 USD Annual

View the U.S. work location and transparency guide to find the pay range for your location.

Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Beverage Carton
jobs.description:
Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description

Position Summary:

The Senior Manager, Operating Unit Engineering – Beverage is responsible for providing technical leadership and engineering support across multiple gable-top carton manufacturing facilities. This role drives safety, quality, operational performance, equipment reliability, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the operating unit. The position serves as the technical authority for Lithographic Offset Printing, Flexographic Printing, HD Flexographic Printing, rotary and flatbed score-and-cut tooling, and water-based, UV, and Electron Beam (EB) ink technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Lead engineering activities across beverage carton manufacturing operations; drive safety, quality, throughput, yield, uptime, and scrap reduction initiatives; provide technical leadership to plant engineering and operations teams; support capital projects, equipment commissioning, and process optimization efforts.

Specialized Technical Leadership

Provide subject matter expertise in Lithographic Offset Printing, Conventional Flexographic Printing, HD Flexographic Printing, Rotary Die Cutting and Scoring, Flatbed Die Cutting and Scoring Tooling, Gable-Top Carton Converting, Water-Based Ink Systems, UV Ink Systems, EB Ink and Coating Systems, and Color Management Processes.

Process Engineering Responsibilities

Optimize print quality, color consistency, registration control, tooling performance, carton dimensional accuracy, coating performance, and manufacturing efficiency. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for process defects and quality issues.

Manufacturing Excellence

Drive OEE improvement, downtime reduction, yield improvement, scrap reduction, changeover optimization, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.

Capital Projects & Commercialization

Develop scopes of work, equipment specifications, business cases, and implementation plans. Support FAT/SAT activities, commissioning, startup, and commercialization of new products and technologies.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical discipline. Minimum 10 years of manufacturing engineering experience with at least 5 years supporting carton converting, packaging, printing, or paperboard manufacturing operations. Experience with gable-top beverage packaging preferred.

Travel

Up to 75% travel to manufacturing facilities, suppliers, and customer locations as required.

Success Metrics

Safety performance, print quality, OEE improvement, scrap reduction, downtime reduction, capital project execution, tooling optimization, and successful implementation of engineering standards across manufacturing sites.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $145,000-$165,000 + bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Novolex, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

The benefits for this role include 401(k) plan with company match, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending and health savings accounts, paid vacation, and sick days, paid parental leave, paid holidays and wellness program.

Company Benefits

What You'll Get From Us
Benefits

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

Community Engagement

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

Training and Development

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

Novolex is committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all employment practices, including but not limited to selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, handicap or disability, genetics, citizenship status, service member or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. Any individual who, because of his or her disability, needs an accommodation in connection with an aspect of the Company's application process should contact myHRservices@novolex.com .

What you will do:

As our Senior Manager, EDT Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), you will lead the end-to-end platform ownership and delivery of Stryker's Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) environment, which powers Stryker.com and 50+ country sites globally as the foundation of Stryker's Digital Marketing Program. You will partner directly with the Digital Marketing organization, EDT business partners, Marketing Operations, and external system integrators to drive scalable content authoring, content globalization, comprehensive campaign insights, and modern cloud architecture across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), and integrated Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities. Additionally, you will lead a team of full-time employees and managed-service partners spanning AEM technical architects, backend/frontend developers, DevOps engineers, QA, and analytics consultants, ensuring the platform delivers on brand consistency, speed-to-market, operational efficiency, and enhanced customer experience objectives aligned with Stryker's Mission.

Own the end-to-end AEMaaCS platform strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), Dynamic Media, Multi-Site Manager (MSM), and the AEM Translation Integration Framework (TIF).
Lead architecture governance for the component library, page templates, blueprint/live-copy configurations, and language-copy rollouts supporting Stryker.com and 50+ country sites.
Drive modernization efforts (e.g., AMS-to-AEMaaCS migration, technical debt reduction, out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption) to enable scalable content authoring, globalization, and advanced marketing analytics.
Ensure seamless integration between AEM and adjacent platforms including Workfront, Adobe Analytics, Adobe WebSDK, Marketo, Adobe Target, and Adobe Real-Time CDP.
Oversee CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, release management, and the AEM Releases & Deployment Schedule in partnership with DevOps and system integrators.
Partner with the AEM AI initiative team to evaluate and operationalize built-in generative AI capabilities (content creation, asset tagging, experimentation) in alignment with Stryker's AI Operating Committee (AIOC) governance and residual-risk approvals.
Ensure platform compliance with Stryker IT QMS, SOX, CSV, Global Change Control, privacy/consent regulations, and cybersecurity standards.
Execute a robust talent offense by attracting, developing, retaining, and engaging top talent while driving personal/professional growth of individuals and the team, delivering high-quality results with passion, energy, and drive.
Manage a team consisting of full-time employees, contractors, and managed-service partners; define roles and responsibilities, plan for the department's future needs, counsel employees on performance, and contribute to employee pay decisions or changes.
Lead and mentor Solution Leads, Technical Leads, and Solution Analysts across build and run teams (onshore and offshore).
Serve as the EDT single point of accountability for the AEM platform to Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Corporate Communications, and Divisional marketing stakeholders.
Own program schedules, work breakdown structures, and integrated Gantt/roadmap views for the AEM portfolio.

Ensure smooth build-to-run transitions of completed projects and stable production support operations.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Beverage Carton
new_jobs.description:
Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description

Position Summary:

The Senior Manager, Operating Unit Engineering – Beverage is responsible for providing technical leadership and engineering support across multiple gable-top carton manufacturing facilities. This role drives safety, quality, operational performance, equipment reliability, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the operating unit. The position serves as the technical authority for Lithographic Offset Printing, Flexographic Printing, HD Flexographic Printing, rotary and flatbed score-and-cut tooling, and water-based, UV, and Electron Beam (EB) ink technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Lead engineering activities across beverage carton manufacturing operations; drive safety, quality, throughput, yield, uptime, and scrap reduction initiatives; provide technical leadership to plant engineering and operations teams; support capital projects, equipment commissioning, and process optimization efforts.

Specialized Technical Leadership

Provide subject matter expertise in Lithographic Offset Printing, Conventional Flexographic Printing, HD Flexographic Printing, Rotary Die Cutting and Scoring, Flatbed Die Cutting and Scoring Tooling, Gable-Top Carton Converting, Water-Based Ink Systems, UV Ink Systems, EB Ink and Coating Systems, and Color Management Processes.

Process Engineering Responsibilities

Optimize print quality, color consistency, registration control, tooling performance, carton dimensional accuracy, coating performance, and manufacturing efficiency. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for process defects and quality issues.

Manufacturing Excellence

Drive OEE improvement, downtime reduction, yield improvement, scrap reduction, changeover optimization, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.

Capital Projects & Commercialization

Develop scopes of work, equipment specifications, business cases, and implementation plans. Support FAT/SAT activities, commissioning, startup, and commercialization of new products and technologies.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical discipline. Minimum 10 years of manufacturing engineering experience with at least 5 years supporting carton converting, packaging, printing, or paperboard manufacturing operations. Experience with gable-top beverage packaging preferred.

Travel

Up to 75% travel to manufacturing facilities, suppliers, and customer locations as required.

Success Metrics

Safety performance, print quality, OEE improvement, scrap reduction, downtime reduction, capital project execution, tooling optimization, and successful implementation of engineering standards across manufacturing sites.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $145,000-$165,000 + bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Novolex, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

The benefits for this role include 401(k) plan with company match, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending and health savings accounts, paid vacation, and sick days, paid parental leave, paid holidays and wellness program.

Company Benefits

What You'll Get From Us
Benefits

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

Community Engagement

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

Training and Development

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

Novolex is committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all employment practices, including but not limited to selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, handicap or disability, genetics, citizenship status, service member or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. Any individual who, because of his or her disability, needs an accommodation in connection with an aspect of the Company's application process should contact myHRservices@novolex.com .
